schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE clienti (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    indirizzo TEXT,
    codice_fiscale TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    telefono TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE ordini (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    cliente_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES clienti(id),
    data_ordine DATE NOT NULL,
    importo_totale NUMERIC(10,2) CHECK (importo_totale >= 0),
    stato TEXT CHECK (stato IN ('in_attesa', 'spedito', 'consegnato'))
);

query: WITH cte_client_stats AS (SELECT c.id AS cliente_id, c.nome AS nome_cliente, COUNT(o.id) AS totale_ordini, SUM(o.importo_totale) AS totale_speso, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.stato = 'consegnato') AS ordini_consegnati, SUM(CASE WHEN o.stato = 'spedito' THEN o.importo_totale ELSE 0 END) AS totale_spedito FROM clienti c LEFT JOIN ordini o ON c.id = o.cliente_id GROUP BY c.id, c.nome HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 0), cte_ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totale_speso DESC) AS posizione, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY totale_speso DESC) AS rank_spesa FROM cte_client_stats), cte_totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS totale_clienti, SUM(totale_speso) AS totale_complessivo FROM cte_client_stats), cte_no_orders AS (SELECT c.id AS cliente_id, c.nome AS nome_cliente FROM clienti c LEFT JOIN ordini o ON c.id = o.cliente_id WHERE o.id IS NULL), cte_all_clients AS (SELECT cliente_id, nome_cliente FROM cte_ranked UNION SELECT cliente_id, nome_cliente FROM cte_no_orders) SELECT a.nome_cliente, COALESCE(r.totale_speso, 0) AS totale_speso, r.posizione, r.rank_spesa, t.totale_clienti, t.totale_complessivo, (SELECT MAX(importo_totale) FROM ordini o WHERE o.cliente_id = a.cliente_id) AS max_ordine_singolo, r2.nome_cliente AS prossimo_cliente FROM cte_all_clients a LEFT JOIN cte_ranked r ON a.cliente_id = r.cliente_id CROSS JOIN cte_totals t LEFT JOIN cte_ranked r2 ON r.posizione + 1 = r2.posizione WHERE COALESCE(r.posizione, 999) <= 3 ORDER BY COALESCE(r.totale_speso, 0) DESC LIMIT 3;
